posts.title: Decision Models: An LLM With the Talking Taken Out
posts.description: A decision model picks from your list of answers instead of writing a reply. Built up from how an LLM works to reading answer probabilities from GPT-2 and Qwen2.5, a trained head, and the internals of Laya, an open decision model.

posts.title: Harness Engineering 101
posts.description: A blog series about building AI agents from first principles. An LLM API is stateless: every turn you send the whole conversation as a JSON array and get text back. A harness is the program that builds, maintains, and protects that array; everything the field calls agents is a set of patches to that one loop.

posts.title: Context Beats the Model: Building a Domain-Specific Coding Agent
posts.description: How we built WSO2 Integrator Copilot, a domain-specific coding agent with 23 tools, 4 subagents, an on-demand knowledge graph, and a caching strategy that hits 81-90% prompt cache reuse.
